case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1198 OF 2023; Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 1655 of 2023
summary: Bail plea in money laundering case; predicate offence FIR registered 2013 (IPC Sections 406, 407, 415-420, 120B) but pending for nine years; ECIR filed 2022 under PMLA based on SEBI order finding fraudulent GDR scheme; appellant CA professional argued as mere service provider without possession of 'proceeds of crime'; Enforcement Directorate alleged kingpin role in orchestrating GDR fraud causing $15.6M loss; Section 45 PMLA twin conditions analysis; no final report in predicate offence; Srinivas Reddy also arrested but remand rejected; bail granted with passport surrender and court appearance conditions.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; bail granted subject to conditions including passport surrender and regular court appearances.
